verdict.rationale: The only relevant evidence is the API's documented option to export each transcript to additional formats, so transcript output can be taken out per request. Nothing documents an account-wide export of all user data, the specific formats, or an offboarding path. missing for 10: bulk/account-level data export, confirmation that export formats are open (e.g. SRT/TXT/JSON named), export of stored history and settings, documented account deletion/offboarding, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave

citations.quote: A list of additional formats to export the transcript to.
